# Archived versions

- `FPSMaxx-1.0.0-mc26.2.jar` - archived 1.0.0 build (formerly labeled 1.1.0), recovered from the local build cache.
- `FPSMaxx-1.1.1-mc26.2.jar` - archived 1.1.1 build (formerly labeled 1.2.0), before the low-end optimization pass.
- `FPSMaxx-1.2.0-mc26.2.jar` - archived 1.2.0 low-end optimization build.
- `FPSMaxx-1.3.0-mc26.2.jar` - archived 1.3.0 build with the potato preset and chunk-update budgeting.
- `FPSMaxx-1.4.0-mc26.2.jar` - archived 1.4.0 build with the hidden preset and Fresh & Smooth support.
- `FPSMaxx-1.4.1-mc26.2.jar` - archived final Fabric 26.2 build with the searchable Sodium FPSMaxx page.
- `fabric-api-0.161.0+26.2.jar` - legacy Fabric API required by the 26.2 builds above.

The current Fabric and NeoForge 26.3 builds are in `dist/mods/`.
